svg.title: How MASQUE works
svg.desc: Animated diagram. Without MASQUE a VPN packet is detected by a firewall and dropped. With MASQUE the packet is wrapped in HTTP/3 over QUIC, looks like normal HTTPS, passes the firewall, and is unwrapped at the Cloudflare WARP endpoint.
svg.text: Tunnel your traffic inside HTTP/3 + QUIC so it blends in with ordinary HTTPS
A plain VPN handshake has a recognizable fingerprint → detected & dropped
MASQUE Config Generator · WARP MASQUE → Xray
